title: Learning objectives
description: What this assessment measures. Every student is tested on the same objectives in the same proportions.
extractingBody: Objectives are being extracted from the uploaded material. This page updates by itself.
failedBody: Add objectives manually, or try regenerating them.
lockedBody: This assessment is being published or has been published, so its objectives can no longer change.
saved: Objectives saved. The question plan has been updated.
weightHint: Higher weight means more questions on that objective.
waitingBody: They will appear here in a moment.
noneBody: Add the outcomes this assessment should measure.
planAdaptive: Questions per student: {{count}}. Difficulty adapts to each student.
planFixed: Questions per student: {{count}}. Fixed difficulty mix.
regenerateBody: The current objectives, including your edits, will be replaced by a new AI-generated list.
stalledTitle: This is taking longer than usual
stalledBody: Reading the material has not finished yet. Try again to restart it, or add objectives yourself.
untestedBody: Each student answers {{questions}} questions, but there are {{objectives}} objectives, so some are never tested. Remove or merge objectives, or add more questions to the assessment.
